issues.description: Method parameter type mismatch for method 'addGuestStudents'. The problem statement text (problem_statement.md line 50) instructs students to implement addGuestStudents(String), while the UML in the same problem statement (problem_statement.md line 73) declares addGuestStudents(int): void and the reference solution implements public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 90). This inconsistency can confuse students about the correct method signature and lead to incorrect implementations or compilation/test failures if they follow the textual description instead of the UML/solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type consistent across all artifacts. Update problem_statement.md (line 50) to specify addGuestStudents(int) to match the UML and the reference implementation. Alternatively, if a String parameter was intended, change the UML and the solution implementation to use String and update the template TODO accordingly. Prefer using addGuestStudents(int) because the method represents adding a numeric count; ensure the template TODO and any tests reflect the chosen signature.
